target_customer: US and UK consumer packaged goods brands with 20M dollars or more in retail revenue selling through UNFI, KeHE and DSD distributors
problem: CPG brands receive fragmented sell-out data from distributor and retailer portals and ERPs. Corvera unifies it and turns it into daily ranked sales actions for reps.
business_model: B2B SaaS for CPG brands; pricing not published
product_category: AI sales and operations agent for CPG

founders.name: Christopher Kong
previous_startups: Better Nature, tempeh brand, co-founder and CEO (stepped back in 2025)

founders.name: Matthew Collins
founders.background_notes: Named in the YC launch post and tech.eu, not on the YC profile founder list.

competitors.name: Crisp
competitors.what: CPG sell-out data platform that added AI agents for UNFI and other distributor data
competitors.traction_then: ranked 11th fastest growing AI and data company on the 2026 Inc. 5000 per its own page

technical_complexity.rationale: Normalizing messy distributor, retailer and ERP data and matching SKUs and stores is laborious but standard data engineering plus LLM agents.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with distributor portals create some lock in, but Crisp already offered normalized distributor data and AI agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Crisp announced AI agents in 2026. No acquisition of Corvera found.

market_need_then: The company lists 18 CPG brand logos and customer testimonials from Clean Cause, Wild and BOL Foods, which are self reported. Crisp itself says distributor data arrives through inconsistent portals.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and operator focused, for example built for operators who move fast.

branding.community_and_virality: Seed round covered by tech.eu, Crowdfund Insider and UK trade outlets; the CEO is a Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree per press.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive coined name with press around the seed round, but no brand assets or community evidence.

pivots.from: AI back office operations for CPG (order processing, inventory, forecasting)
pivots.to: AI sales agent producing daily ranked actions
pivots.why: The YC launch post describes the earlier operations focus while the current profile describes an AI sales agent; reason and exact date not stated.

outcome_analysis: Corvera joined YC in Winter 2026 and announced a 4.2 million dollar seed round led by 6 Degrees Capital in May 2026. A CEO who built the Better Nature food brand gives founder market fit with CPG buyers. Its focus moved from back office operations to sales actions. It is too early for an outcome, and Crisp is a close competitor.
notes: Amount conflicts: 4.2M dollars (3M pounds) in most outlets, 3.8M dollars in one, and the YC profile says about 6.2M dollars raised, which suggests earlier money. An aggregator reports an earlier 2M dollar round led by Firstminute Capital, unverified and not recorded. Seedtable lists Rebel Fund as lead; most sources say 6 Degrees Capital. Headquarters and founding year reported inconsistently (London versus San Francisco).
